(379)༄/ /jo bo rjes rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa sgrub pa'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so/ //

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (379)༄// jo bo rjes rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa sgrub pa'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so///

(380)༄༅// rgya gar skad du// gu ru gu ṇa dharm+ma ka rā nā ma// bod skad du// bla ma'i yon tan chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba// bstan pa'i rtsa lag skyes mchog bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skye rgu nyon mongs tshad pas gdung ba la// chos kyi dbyings nas byams pa'i sprin byung ste// thugs rje'i char gyis gdung ba sel mdzad pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gus btud de// de yi rnam thar dri med rgya mtsho las// sgro skur tshig gi spros pa ma zhugs par// rang gi blo gros rtsal dang sbyar ba'i phyir// chu thigs tsam zhig gus pas blang gis nyon// rgya gar shar phyogs za hor yul phyogs na// bhaṃ ga la zhes bya ba'i grong khyer yod// de yi sa bdag chos kyi rgyal po ni// dge ba dpal zhes rgyal srid bsod nams 'bar// de yi pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can// mi khyim 'bum phrag gcig gis kun nas bskor// khrus kyi rdzing bu stong phrag nyi shu lnga// skyed mos tshal rab bdun brgya nyi shus bskor// ta la'i ljon shing stong phrag lnga bcu drug /'bangs kyi skye bo 'bum phrag sum cu lnga// grong khyer de la ra ba rim pa bdun// bar gyi zom pa sum brgya drug cu gsum// gser gyi rgyal mtshan stong phrag nyi shu lnga// dbus kyi pho brang rgya phibs bcu gsum pa// longs spyod stobs (381)'byor rgya nag stong 'khun ltar// mnga' ris lha dbang brgya byin nyid dang mtshungs// skye bo'i 'du tshogs grong khyer spos ldan 'dra// chos 'byor rgyas pa chos 'phags nyid dang mtshungs// chos kyi rgyal po de yi btsun mo ni// dpal mo 'od zer can te lha mo 'dra// ngo tsha khrel yod mdzes pa'i 'od chags ma// dkon mchog gsum mchod skye bo yongs kyi ma// lha mo de la sras gsum 'khrungs pa ni// dpal dang zla ba padma'i snying po ste// gsum gyi rnam bzhag de ni zur tsam lags// chung shos zla ba'i snying por grags pa de// deng sang bdag gi bla ma dam pa yin// skal pa bzang po yum la bltams pa'i tshe// rgyal po'i khab tu me tog char pa babs// nam mkha'i mthong rnams 'jal tshon gur gyis gtams// lha yi glu dbyangs skye bo yongs kyis thos// thams cad dga' zhing dag pa'i snang ba thob// zla ba bco brgyad bar du khab gnas su// ma ma brgyad kyis bkur bsti mchod pas bskyangs// de nas pho brang de yi byang phyogs na// bri ka ma la pu ri ces pa yod// gnas der bde gshegs mchod pa byed pa la// yab yum blon 'bangs shing rta lnga brgyar bcas// khye'u bu mo mdzes pa'i chas kyis spras// rol mo mkhan po brgya phrag du mas (382)bskor// rin chen mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa bsnams// glu skad len cing lam du zhugs pa na// bla ma 'di ni lo gsum lon 'dra ba'i// gzugs bzang bzhin mdzes blta bas mi ngoms shing*// dbu rgyan la sogs lha yi rgyan chas spras// pañtsa li ka'i gos gsol rgyal pos bsnams// skye bo rnams kyis lha de mthong ba dang*// dga' bas dbugs 'byin bde ba'i dpal dang ldan// chags pas blta zhing 'bral bar mi phong skad// de nas mthong ba'i skye bos 'di skad du// khyod nyid 'khrungs nas me tog char pa babs// nyi mas gur phub snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs thos// nam zhig mthong zhes yid smon shes pa 'tshor// da ni mthong ngo ya mtshan ltad mo che// de nas rgyal bu dam pas tshig smras pa// pha ma skye bo 'di dag su zhig yin// yab yum gnyis kyis smras pa/

skye bo 'di rnams khyod kyi 'bangs 'khor yin// rgyal bu dam pas de la lan smras pa// 'di dag bdag bzhin pha ma phun tshogs shing*// rgyal srid mnga' thang bsod nams 'bar ba yis// mi dbang sras kyi thu bor rab bskrun te// thams cad dam pa'i chos kyis 'tsho bar shog /de nas ka ma la yi gtsug lag tu// 'khor dang bcas pa legs par slebs pa dang*// rgyal bus dkon mchog rten la phyag 'tshal zhing*// snyan pas bstod dbyangs 'di skad brjod gyur te// bdag ni dal 'byor mi dbang lus thob cing*// skyon med dbang po dkon mchog gsum 'brang zhing*// rtag tu gus pas dkon mchog spyi bor blangs// de ring nyid nas skyabs gnas mdzad du gsol// zhes gsungs pa/ de nas yab yum blon 'bangs thams cad dang*// dge slong mang pos rgyal bu'i tshig de thos// shin tu dga' zhing ya mtshan skyes par gyur// thams cad mthun par dam par kha tshon bcad// de nas (383)rgyal po yab yum 'khor bcas kyis// bsnyen bkur mchod yon bsod nams bsags gyur te// bdag cag tshe rabs dag nas tshe rabs su// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul ba dang*// dge 'dun bkur sti dam chos bstan par shog /nyon mongs gdung sel rang dbang yod par shog /smon lam 'debs pa'i tshig de thos pa dang*// rgyal po yab yum bdag la lta bzhin du// nam yang khyim pa'i chos kyis ma bcings par// dge 'dun dbus su chos sbyor thob pa dang*// nga rgyal med cing dkon mchog mchod byed cing*// skye bo yongs la snying rjes blta bar shog /rgyal bu'i gsung de kun gyis thos pa dang*// yab yum la sogs ya mtshan skyes par gyur// de ni bla ma'i chos kyi thog ma yin// de nas rgyal bus lo gsum lon pa na// rtsis dang yi ge sgra la mkhas par gyur// de nas rgyal bus lo drug lon pa na// phyi nang gnyis kyi bye brag phyed par gyur// de nas bzung ste dgung lo bcu yi bar// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// bsnyen gnas bsrung zhing sbyin pa gtong ba dang*// gtsug lag lta zhing kha ton byed pa dang*// gsol ba 'debs shing dam pa tshol ba dang*// pha ma bkur zhing zhe sas mchod pa dang*// glu gar thams cad chos la rtse ba dang*// chos pa mthong na rgyang nas bsu ba dang*// 'khor la lta zhing snying rjes skyong ba dang*// 'jig rten mgon med skyong ba la sogs pa// dam pa'i spyod pa dpag tu med pa mdzad// rgyal bus dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa na// pha bzang bu mo nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam// blon 'bangs rnams kyis gnyen du gsol ba la// yab yum gnyis kyang de la bya dga' ster// nyin gcig rgyal pos blon po rnams bsdus nas// nang par (384)shing rta bcu gsum legs par chos// kun la mdzes pa'i rgyan cha du ma gyis// dbus su lhag par mdzes shing btsun pa yi// steng na rma bya'i gdugs phub bsil yab bsten// dbus su rin chen khri stegs mdzes pa la// dar zab gos steng zla ba'i snying po bzhag

/shing rta bcu gnyis rgyan gyis spras pa la// blon po thams cad mdzes pa'i chas su zhugs// dga' ba'i glu len rol mo du ma bgyis// shing rta dkar po gsum gyis sna drangs la// shing rta dmar po gsum gyis mjug nas bsten// shing rta ser po gsum gyis g.yas brten la// shing rta ljang gu gsum gyis g.yon nas brten// shing rta re rer khye'u lnga brgya bzhugs// phyogs phyogs kha dog mthun par lha rgyan brten// rgyal bu'i shing rta kha dog sna lnga la// zur bzhir rma bya mjibs bsnol mdzes par gyis// phyogs nas mchod pa'i lha mos kun nas bskor// 'khor rnams pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga dang*// sil snyan la sogs mdzes pa'i sgra 'byin zhing*// skye bo'i yid dbang 'phrog pas kun nas bskor// de nas grong khyer chen po'i mtha' logs su// skyed mos tshal rab shin tu nyams dga' bar// lta ba'i rtsed mos skye bo dbang du sdud// de yi yun kyang zla ba phyed kyi bar// skye bo thams cad dga' bas chags par gyis// de nas skye bo yongs kyis khrom bskor la// rgyal bu mnyes pa'i bu mo sta gon gyis// blon po dag gis bu mo mthong ba dang*// phyogs su bka' bsgo dam bzhag brten par gyis// rgyal po chen pos de ltar bgo ba dang*// nyi ma bdun la blon po thams cad kyis// shing rta bcu gsum byas shing rgyan gyis spras// rgyal bu shing rta'i dbus su rgyan gyis spras// shing rta bcu gnyis rol mo mkhan po yis// gang zhing rol mo rnam pa sna tshogs byas// de nas grong (385)khyer chen po'i mtha' logs dang*// bzhi mdo rnams dang skyed mos tshal rab dang*// skye bo'i yid dbang 'dzin pa'i rtsed mo byas// de yi phyogs dang grong khyer thams cad du// zla ba'i snying po 'khor tshogs nyis stong dang*// lnga brgyar bcas shing shing rta'i nang du zhugs// grong khyer mtha' logs padma'i tshal rab dang*// bzhi mdo bzhi mdo kun nas yod pa na// 'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bu skye bo bsdu// thams cad der 'gro sprul pa'i sku der blta// 'od zer lha mo la sogs bu mi tshogs// rigs kyi tsha bo de yi grangs gnyen pa// kun kyang blta phyir phyogs der 'gro'o zhes// skye bo'i tshogs rnams bltas mor 'dus pa na// rgyal po bsod nams 'dzin gyi bu mo dang*// rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin gyi bu mo dang*// rgyal po chu bdag 'dzin gyi bu mo dang*// rgyal po gtum mo la yi bu mo sogs// rigs gzugs longs spyod dpung gis rgyal ba yis// nyi shu rtsa gnyis gnyen khar sleb pa yang*// shing rta re na bu mo bdun bdun te// bu mo re la g.yog mo bdun bdun zhing*// shing rta nyi shu rtsa gnyis mdzes pa yang*// rkyen cha sna tshogs rgyan rab rab spras te// snyan pa'i sgra 'byin dga' ba'i sems kyis 'ong*// thams cad lha yi bu mo 'khod pa ltar// rgyal bus mthong bas chags pa'i mig gis btung*// kun nas chags shing lus kyi ba spu g.yo// de tshe mkha' 'gro ma yi sprul pa zhig

/bu mo sngo sangs gcig tu sku sprul te// glu dbyangs tshig gis bskul ba 'di skad do// lha gcig ma chags ma chags skal pa can// 'dam bu'i tshal du glang po bying ba ltar// 'dod pa'i 'dam 'dir dpa' bo khyod bying na// tshul khrims gos can bsnub par ma gyur tam// skye ba lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis su// paṇa chen dge slong gtsang ma'i lus blangs nas// (386)padma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'jug pa ltar// khyod ni tshe 'dir rab tu 'byung 'gyur lags// grong khyer gnas na bu mo byi dor can// tshul khrims mdangs 'phrog bdud kyi pho nya mo// dga' dga' lta bur khyod la bslu brid byed// shes par gyis shig rgyal bu gzugs mdzes po// zla ba zhun ma mtsho la gsal ba ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyogs pa med pa'i sku// zur phud lnga pa lha yi rgyan cha can// rab mdzes skye bo yongs kyi yid 'phrog po// rnyed dka' dal 'byor rin chen thob dus su// thos bsam sgom pas mi tshe 'da' dgos pas// bdag rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi zad pa// the tshom bcad phyir rab tu brten 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma des 'di skad smras pa dang*// rgyal bu 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyung lan smras pa// legs so legs so shin tu legs// shes rab sras po nags kyi nang na bde// rma bya'i bde skyid btsan dug nags na yod// goms pa'i stobs kyis ngang pa mtsho na bde// bya rog mi gtsang khrod du 'jug pa ltar// padma'i tshal du de ltar ga la yin// tha mal grong gi gnas su phebs pa ltar// rigs ldan bdag ni de ltar ga la yin// sngon tshe rgyal bu don rnams grub pa des// zas gtsang rgyal po'i rgyal srid dpal 'byor la// mi gtsang 'dam bu bzhin du rab skyo nas// btsun mo drug khri spangs nas thar pa sgrub// thub dbang 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa yi// kun nas bsngags par gyur zhing mchod byed na// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i chos rgyal des// mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshul gyis byang chub brnyes// kho bo ci ste rgyal srid ma spangs par// 'dod pa'i 'dam 'dir chags pa 'phel bar byed// grogs rnams thams cad bdud kyi bslu brid yin// 'dod yon thams cad lan tshwa'i chu bor shes// (387)da ni mkhas pa'i bla ma mang 'tshol zhing*// lus 'dis byang chub mchog rab bsgrub par bgyi// 'dod yon dag la rtse dga' bag phebs kyang*// chu zla lta bur snying po mi gda' lags// brag cha lta bur brjod bya mi gda' lags// sprul pa lta bur ngos bzung mi gda' lags// gzugs brnyan lta bur rang tshugs mi gda' lags// nyon mongs kun gzhi'i rgya mtsho yangs pa 'dir// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo rgyun du 'bab// sngon chad ngan song las kyis dbang med na// deng sang phun sum tshogs tshe cis mi tshol// da ni 'khor ba spyi la nges bsam nas// bla ma bsten nas dam pa'i chos la spyod// rgyal bu'i chos kyi gsung de thos pa dang*// grong khyer pa yi skye bo thams cad kyang*// brjod tshul 'di yis rgyal srid cang 'dzin nam// 'dzin kyang chos kyi rgyal por the tshom med// gzhan du mkhas grub bla ma rab brten zhing*// shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal srid 'dzin 'dzin 'dra// ngo mtshar che'o zhes pa'i sgra yang sgrogs// lhag par chags shing bskor nas yang yang blta// rigs bzang gnyen du bsgrigs pa'i bu mo yang*// mthong bas dga' yang gsung des mya ngan gyur// pha ma'i drung du phyin nas 'di skad du// rgyal bu dam pa 'khor bas skyo zhes gda'// rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byon zhes gda'// don grub gzhon nu btsun mo 'dor zhes gda'// 'khor gyi tshogs la chags par ma gyur skad// da ni yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa yis// myur du rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du brdzangs// rgyal bu chags pa'i bya ba sna tshogs kyis// nor dang longs spyod du mas sems gzung zhes// bu mo bdag gis pha ma rnams la bskul// phan tshun pha ma blon 'bangs bcas pa yis// brtson pa bskyed de rgyal bu nyams dga' ba'i// glu gar byed cing bu mo dag (388)kyang bsdus// kun nas khab tu 'byung bar nye ba na// rgyal bus rta pa brgya dang sum cur bcas// dmag gi chas zhugs ri brag bskor ba na// ri brag zhig na bram ze dze tā ri// bram ze'i chas kyis snyan ngag sgra 'byin zhing*// gtsang ma'i chas kyis drang srong spyi bos len// nyon mongs dgra las rnam par rgyal ba mthong*// rgyal bu'i chibs kyi steng nas ma gzhol bar// drang srong de la tshig ni 'di skad zhus// dben pa'i khrod na dka' thub lus can khyod// gtsang ma'i tshul gyis dag pa'i 'tsho ba za// 'dod yon spangs te drang srong bkur ba las// yon tan rnam pa gang zhig thob pa lags// ces smras pa dang*/

bram zes mig kyang blta bar mi byed pa// rgyal bu'i lan du 'di skad blan par dgongs// nam gzhug 'chad ka'i me tog ldum ra ltar// rgyal pos bram ze'i dpal 'byor bkug gyur kyang*// las kyi dbang gis ngan 'gror 'phen pa la// phyi thag snying po mchis nas gnas 'dir bsdad// ba glang khyi phag lta bu'i brtul zhugs kyis// mi gtsang 'dam bu'i srin bur skyes dogs nas// dka' thub spyod cing gtsang spras nags 'di brten// sgyu ma'i nor la snying po ma mthong nas// pha rol bsam zhing drang srong spyi bos blangs// rgyal bus bram ze'i tshig de thos pa dang*// kha tshod blta phyir tshig gis lan smras pa// dge sbyong rnams ni nga rgyal gzhan pas che// sa yi bdag po 'ong tshe cis mi ldang*// bram ze chen pos tshig gis lan smras pa// sa bdag su zhig khyod ni gang nas 'ong*// dgra bshes med phyir khyod ni ma shes so// nga la nor med nags khrod dag na bde// lus srog 'di la dgra bo 'chi bdag yin// nga rgyal med phyir bdag gis 'du 'dzi spangs// bram ze'i tshig de thos nas lan smras pa// nga ni gser gyi rgyal mtshan can nas 'ong*// (389)nga ni mi gral nas bud khrims las 'das// nga la dpon med g.yog med ngo bsrung med// ces pa'i lan du/ sa bdag 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba'i tshe// rta med grogs med rkang thang gcig pur rgyu// lto med gos med gcig pur bar dor 'khyams// gnas med yul med rgyus med shul thag ring*// rgyal po'i bu yang nam gzhug ma mchis pas// don des bdag ni nags 'dir dben pa lags// ces pa dang*/ rgyal bus bram ze'i tshig de gsan gyur nas// chibs las gzhol te 'khor gsum drung du phul// gus pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// mkhas pa khyod kyi skyon yon brtags pa'i phyir// nga rgyal lta bur dregs pa'i tshig de smras// gang yang bdag gis nyin mtshan dus drug tu// 'khor ba'i skyon bsam nges par yid dbyung ste// rgyal srid spangs te thar par 'byung 'dod na// bram ze khyed kyis bdag la bzung du gsol// zhes pa dang*/

bram ze chen pos de la lan smras pa// tshur shog nga rgyal rlung gis ma dkrugs par// bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis brlab kyis shog /gsungs nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyis byin brlabs sems bskyed gnang*// rgyal bu yar bzhengs slar yang mi rta rnams// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yon du rje la phul// rgyal bu'i tshogs rnams yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir// re zhig blangs nas gdams ngag 'di skad gsungs// rgyal bu re zhig rtog dpyod ma btang ba'i// tshe 'di'i che thabs 'dre rkyen dag kyang byed// rang don tsam zhig khra dang spyang ki'ang byed// rang sangs rgyas kyang bla med ga la sgrub// lto 'grangs tsam zhig bran gyi tshogs kyang za// skye ba gtan du rgyal po 'dag la 'grangs// rgyal bu snying rus sems la brten 'tshal lo// rgyal srid spangs te (390)thar pa bsgrub 'tshal lo// slar yang rgyal bu dam pas slar gsol pa// bla ma nga ni rgyal po'i pho brang na// bzang brtson dar gyi bcud mos legs bsdams ltar// dang po nyon mongs las kyis gnyen 'thoms shing*// thams cad dga' dga' lta bu'i bslu srid kyis// kho bo srid pa'i 'dam du bying gin yod// nga ni rgyal pos mnar bar mi nus par// bla ma khyod kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa dang*/ de la bram ze chen pos 'di skad gsungs// rigs brgyud srid pa'i 'ching bdag chen po yin// rgyal srid mi gtsang 'dam rdzab chen po yin// rgyal po bdud kyi gces ming chen po yin// blon rnams bdud kyi pha tshan chen po yin// nges par khyod ni myur bar mnar ta re// 'di ru ma 'dug na lend+ra ru song*// de na thog med dus na nyer 'brel ba'i// khyod kyi bla ma byang chub bzang po yod// sems bskyed chos zhus las kyi 'brel pa zhog /mkhas pa de yis khyod la phan zhes gsungs// de ma thag tu bram ze chen po yis// slar yang 'bul ba thams cad phyir byin nas// khyim nas byung ste nges par drung 'dir shog

/man ngag du mas khyod ni skyong zhes gsungs// de nas rgyal bu rgyal po'i khab tu 'ong*// gser dngul la sogs 'byor pa du ma blangs// 'khor dang bcas te na lend+ra ru phyin// na lend+ra yi rgyal po bred gyur nas// dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas te rgyang nas bsu// mjal te rgyal bus gtam de yar phul bas// sa yi rgyal po khyod ni ga nas lhag /'khor los sgyur 'dra khyod ni gang du bltams// dmag gi chas kyis rgol ba gang du 'joms// rgyang nas mthong ste khyod kyi drung du 'ongs// ces pa dang*/ rgyal bus lan smras pa/ nga ni shar phyogs za hor yul nas 'ong*// pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can nas 'ong*// da ni srid (391)pa'i dgra bo 'joms su 'gro// 'chi bdag bdud kyi dgra bo 'joms su 'gro// zhes pa dang*/ na lend+ra yi rgyal pos lan smras pa// khyod ni shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i sras// sa yi bdag po chos rgyal dge ba dpal// 'khor los sgyur 'dra nag po'i phyogs las rgyal// mi dbang sras po zhing 'dir byon pa legs// khyod ni bri ka ma la pu ri na// dkon mchog pho brang lha yi gzhal yas 'dra// rab tu byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs// mkhas pa'i paṇa chen nyi zla lta bur yong*// sa bdag khyod ni mkhas pa su zhig bzhed// ces pa dang*/ de nas rgyal bu dam pas lan smras pa// chos grwa chen po dpal gyi na lend+rar// rgya mtsho lta bu'i nor bu rin chen gling*// paṇa chen gnam gyi skar ma lta bu yod// mchog tu bsngags pa byang chub bzang po de// bram zes lung bstan bdag gi bla ma yin// sa bdag khyod kyis bar chad bsal du gsol// de la rgyal po chen pos lan smras pa// dpa' bo chen po bodhi bha dra de// ri rgyal lhun po gangs kyis g.yogs pa ltar// mi 'gul lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs// rnam thos sras de nor la spyod pa ltar// de ni 'phags pa'i nor la skal pa brnyes// tshur du bdag gi pho brang 'khor du byon// mnyan pa'i gtam dang dpal 'byor rol par bya// rgyal bus legs so zhes ni brjod pa dang*// rgyal pos bsu ba yis ni mdun brdar nas// rol mo 'bul kyin na lend+ra ru byon// de yi lho phyogs padma can ljongs na// pho brang kun tu bzang po zhes pa yi// mi khyim 'bum phrag gcig gis bskor ba yod// de yi nang du rgyal bu gdan drangs nas// rin chen mdzes pa'i khri steng yangs pa la// rgyal po rang bas bkur bsti che bar mdzad// de nas na lend+ra yi gtsug lag tu// (392)bla ma byang chub bzang po'i drung du byon// de yi gtsug lag khang du slebs pa dang*// bla ma mthong nas shin tu mi bzod pa'i// dga' ba khyad par du 'phags rgyud la skyes// bla ma dam pa byang chub bzang pos kyang*// rgyal bu dam pa byon pa gsan pa des// shin tu dgyes nas stan las yar bzhengs nas// snyan pa'i tshig gis chos kyi gsung byon pa// chos rgyal sras po gnas 'dir byon lags sam// mi yi dbang po gzhi lam bde lags sam// za hor yul na chos 'byor rgyas lags sam// shul ring lam la bsnyel bar ma gyur tam// de tshe rgyal bu dam pas lan gsol pa// 'dir 'ong yang bde chos dang mthun par bdog

/lam bde deng sang khyed dang mjal bar gyur// mkhas pa khyed ni sangs rgyas bstan pa la// thos bsam sgom pas bsnyel bar ma gyur tam// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas legs kyi kho bo yang*// dam pa chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar gyur// rgyal bu stan la 'dug la gang dgos gsol// de nas rgyal bus gus par phyag btsal nas// rin chen mchod pas bla ma mnyes par mdzad// gus pa'i tshig gis zhu ba 'di ltar phul// 'gro ba'i bla ma brtse ba'i gtam 'di gson// nga ni 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab mi zad pa// bslu brid rgyal po chen pos mnar dogs nas// dpung dang bcas te nags su phyin pa na// bla ma dgra las rnam rgyal bzhugs te gda'// de la sems skyed gsol ba btab pa'i tshe// mkhas pa'i dbang pos thugs rjes rab gzigs nas// chos grwa chen po na lend+ra ru song*// skye ba sngon nas thugs rjes rab bzung ba'i// bla ma dam pa byang chub bzang po yod// de la sems bskyed gdams ngag zhus zhes gsung*// de ma thag tu rang gi pho brang nas// mchod rdzas blangs te de ring gnas 'dir slebs// da ni bdag la brtse ba'i thugs rje (393)yis// sems bskyed gdams pa du ma gnang du gsol// de ma thag tu stan la 'dug pa dang*// bla ma ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag nas// sgo gsum las su rung bar byin gyis brlabs// de nas sems bskyed gdams pa du ma gnang*// de yang gdams ngag bstan pa 'di ltar lags// rgyal bu tshe 'dir don yod thob pa lags// rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa ma sgrub na// las kyi dbang gis ngan 'gro ltung ba'i tshe// shin tu 'gyod de nges par 'chi ba yin// skye ba gtan gyi btsan sa 'dzin dus 'dir// dka' ba chen pos brtson 'grus ma rtsom na// thar pa'i sgos skal nges par stor ba'i tshe// phyin chad bzung du med do rigs kyi bu// dpa' zhing brtan la go cha phun tshogs kyang*// pha rol 'phrang la gshed mas khrid pa'i tshe// mthu med nyam thag 'gyod pa tsam zhig las// phan pa'i dgos pa ci yang ma mchis so// rgyal bu dam pas chos 'di gson mdzod la// na lend+ra yi byang phyogs pha gi na// khyod kyi thog med dus nas phar gyur pa'i// rgyal sras rig pa'i khu byug ces pa yod// tshe mthar phyin zhing g.yeng bas dben pa der// mtha' brgyad spros pa'i dri mas ma gos par// tshul khrims gos can mngon shes thogs med ldan// drung der song la chos kyi gdams pa zhus// mgon po de yi gsung de thos gyur nas// byang chub bzang po de la phreng bzhin du// rig pa'i khu byug bzang po'i drung du phyin// phyag 'tshal mchod pa phul nas 'di skad zhus// nga ni shar phyogs za hor yul nas 'ongs// nga ni bhaṃ ga la yi rgyal po'i sras// pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can nas 'ongs// na lend+ra yi gtsug lag khang du phyin// byang chub bzang po de la sems bskyed zhus// gdams ngag dam pa bstan nas 'di skad gsungs// (394)'di ru ma 'dug byang gi phyogs su song*// de na thogs med dus nas phar gyur pa'i// bla ma rig pa'i khu byug ces pa yod// drung der song la sems bskyed gsol ba thob// des ni khyod la phan par 'gyur zhes gsungs// de ma thag tu rje la phreng gyur kyang*// dga' ba skyes nas khyod kyi drung du 'ong*// kho bo la bkyas mnar bar mi 'gyur bar// bla ma khyod kyis nges par bzung du gsol// de nas bla ma dam pa rab dgyes nas// sa bdag sras po byon pa shin tu legs// tshur shog gnyis su med par byin brlab bya// chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i bden tshig brdar// brtse ba'i sems kyis dam chos bshad ces gsungs// de nas rgyal bus mchod rdzas gus phul nas// bla ma'i drung du phyag btsal thal sbyar te// nga rgyal skyungs nas stan la 'dug pa na// khu byug bzang pos sems bskyed gdams pa gnang*// gdams pa'i gtso bo mchog tu bsngags pa re// rgyal bu tshe 'dir phun sum tshogs gyur kyang*// skye ba gtan kyi so nam ma byas na// dal 'byor mi lus thob pa'i dgos pa chung*// phyi rabs nor shor na yang phongs pa lags// rgyal bu klu sgrub snying po 'di skad gsungs// rmi lam sgyu 'dra rang bzhin spros dang bral// sems nyid ma bcos gyur pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// gang gis 'di gnyis blo la ma bsam na// 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying bar 'gyur ro ang*// rgyal bu don dam mnyam bzhag nam mkha' 'dra// rjes thob sgyu 'dra las 'bras bsam par rigs// bla mas zab mo'i chos de bstan pa na// sbyor ba'i lam brnyes dpe yi ting 'dzin thob// de tshe rje la rtogs pa 'di phul ba// kho bos ting 'dzin gcig la mnyam bzhag tshe// nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba ji bzhin du// gsal la dwangs pa rtog pa mi gda' na// bla ma chos kyi gnas lugs de (395)lags sam// de nas ting 'dzin de las sad pa na// snang yang zhen pa med pa'i sems can dran// brdzun yang phra zhib blo la bag yod thob// bla ma bdag ni nyams de ma 'khrul lam// lan du bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// legs so khyod ni bsod nams bsags pa'i bu// nga ni spro bkur med pa'i dge slong yin// mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bur dag na yang*// rjes thob snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren par byed// bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs de ltar lags// de ni bdag gi gdams ngag dam pa yin// da ni rgyal po'i khab nas 'byung 'dod na// ri bo nag po zom gyi lho phyogs pa// bdag gi bla ma a ba bhū ti yod// de ni khyod kyi sngon gyi bla ma yin// der song de la sems bskyed gdams pa zhus// rgyal po'i khab nas 'byung ba'i gdams pa longs// rgyal bus bla ma'i gsung de thos pa dang*// rje la phreng yang dga' ba mchog skyes nas// phyi phyag btsal te 'khor dang bcas pa yis// dpa' bo'i gzugs su lam du zhugs pa na// na lend+ra yi rgyal po chen po yang*// nor rdzas mang po bdag la 'bad byas te// 'khor dang bcas pas dpag tshad gsum du bskyal// de nas rgyal po phyir la zlog pa'i tshe// rgyal bus phreng ba'i tshig ni slar gsol pa// sa bdag khyod ni bde 'byor thob gyur kyang*// srid pa'i dgra de chom par ma gyur na// phyi nas gshed mas bcings te khrid pa'i tshe// 'gyod par mchis pas chos 'byor sten cig ang*// bsam pa bzang pos do zhag mjal na yang*// mi rtag tshul gyis tshong dus mgron po 'dra// 'bor bar gda' mod brtse bas ma dor bar// chos dang mthun par myur du mjal bar bgyi// rgyal pos kyang ni de la lan gsol pa// skal pa bzang pos deng sang mjal bas chog

/chos rgyal sras dang bcas pa'i yid dbang po// deng song gshegs pas bu la phreng bar gyur// 'on kyang myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal// de nas ri bo zom gyi lho phyogs su// bla ma a wa dhū ti'i spyan sngar phyin// de (396)tshe bla ma skyes mchog dam pa ni// brag gdong nag po gcig gi bya skyibs na// lwa ba nag po gcig ni sku la gsol// kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pa gdan du bting*// sgom thag chen po gcig ni ga shar bcug /sku lus sbom la shin tu gsus khyim che// spyan mig dmar la sha rtsi cung zad sngo// rtog pa med par phyed skyil lus gnad bcas// snod bcud thams cad thod pa gcig tu bsdus// chags pa med par de na bzhugs par mthong*// rgyang nas chibs las gzhol te phyag btsal zhing*// 'khor dang bcas te drung du 'dug pa na// cer re gzigs nas zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// nga rgyal sgang bu ral bar ma gyur tam// nag po'i phyogs kyis mnar bar ma gyur tam// khyim gyi 'dam du bying bar ma gyur tam// bdud kyi bu mos bslus par ma gyur tam// 'phags pa dal 'byor chud zos ma byas sam// rgyal po'i bu dang khyed rnams ga nas 'ong*// thal mo sbyar nas tshig de'i lan gsol ba// kho bo shar phyogs bhaṃ ga la nas 'ong*// pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can nas 'ong*// rgyal srid tshogs la zhen pa log nas 'ong*// 'khor ba'i chos la skyabs gnas zhu ru 'ong*// chos grwa chen po na lend+ra ru phyin// rig pa'i khu byug de la skyabs gnas zhus// pha des kho ba khyed kyi drung du btang*// da ni khyed kyis bdag la bskyab tu gsol// a ba dhū ti'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// kho bo rgyal po'i rigs su skyes na yang*// nyon mongs las kyi tshogs la ches 'jigs nas// rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du spangs// a ba dhū ti'i spyod pa skyong nus sam// rgyal srid 'byor pa dug gi mtsho dang 'dra// 'thung pa tsam gyis thar pa'i srog la 'ong*// rgyal srid 'byor ba me yi 'obs dang 'dra// brgal ba tsam gyis sdug bsngal skyed par byed// de (397)ring phar song rgyal po'i khab tu song*// khyim gyi nyes dmigs ltos la myur du shog

/rgyal bus bla ma'i gsung de thos pa dang*// bsnyen bkur bgyis nas myur du bab tu 'ong*// skye bo rnams kyis rgyal bu mthong ba na// ga sha sgrogs shing glu gar rol mo 'bul// rang gi nang du lhag par gyur pa'i tshe// rgyal po yab yum ches cher dga' ba yis// zla ba'i snying po khyod kyis gang du phyin// de tsam gcig tu dub par ma gyur tam// nyes dmigs mthong nas shes pa ma skye'am// sleb pa legs zhes dga' ba sgrogs pa na// rgyal bu dam pas zhi bas lan smras pa// sa phyogs dag tu nyams dga' rtse ru phyin// bstan pa'i dgra bo thabs kyis 'dul du phyin// thub pa skyabs gnas bla ma tshol du phyin// ri brag dag tu dben gnas tshol du phyin// gang du phyin kyang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong*// su dang 'grogs kyang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad// ci ltar byas kyang shes pa ma phebs na// go skabs phye zhig bdag ni chos la 'gro// de yi lan du pha mas 'di skad gsungs// rgyal bu 'khor ba'i gnas su skye lags na// rgyal srid zung la dkon mchog mchod pa gyis// thugs rje chen pos dbul phongs tshim par gyis// gtsug lag bzhengs la dge 'dun rtag tu theg /phyogs ris med par byams dang snying rje sgoms// de ltar byas na kun tu bde bar 'gyur// rgyal bu dam pas lan smras pa/ brtse ba'i yab gcig bdag la gsan du gsol// nga ni rin chen gser gyi pho brang na// dar gyi bcud mos bsdams te 'khyog med par// pho brang 'di ru bdag ni mnar bar 'gyur// bdag gis 'khor ba 'di la cher bltas shing*// skye bo yongs kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa na// rgyal srid 'di la (398)chags pa'i snang ba ni// mchil ma'i thal ba tsam yang mi gda'o// bdag gis bskor zhing nyin mtshan dus drug tu// khyim gyi nyes dmigs ches cher bsam pa na// mtshar yang bslu brid bdud kyi bu mo la// chags sems skad cig tsam yang mi gda' 'o// bdag gis rdzun snang 'di la bltas tsa na// dkar gsum ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi dang*// mi gtsang mdze klad khyi sha rnag khrag la// khyad par cung zad tsam yang mi gda' 'o// dar zab gos dang g.yu 'bur mdzes pa dang*// lha yi rgyan cha mdzes pas mchod pa dang*// mi gtsang khrod du lwa ba gyon pa la// khyad par cung zad tsam yang mi gda' na// nga 'gro bsam gtan bsgom du nags su 'gro// dur khrod brgyad du rtsed mo rtse ru 'gro// nga 'gro gsang ba'i gnas su dga' bde skyong du 'gro// chags med ro snyoms ldom bu bsten du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro ri bo'i zom du 'gro// rje btsun a ba dhū ti'i drung du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro// rdo rje theg pa'i ro mchog myong du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro u rgyan yul du 'gro// ye shes mkha' 'gro grogs su sdud du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro 'og min gnas su 'gro// rnam snang zhabs la spyi bos brten du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro dga' ldan gnas su 'gro// byams pa'i skyes mchog bla ma brten du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro zhing khams yongs su 'gro// dam pa chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed du 'gro// nga 'gro nga 'gro 'phags pa'i zhing du 'gro// bde ba can 'gro nyams dga' skyong du 'gro// kho bo ma bcings ma bcings dge ba dpal// pha gcig bu la brtse na btsan sar skyol// kho bo ma bcing ma bcings 'od zer can// ma gcig bu la brtse na chos la sbyor// nyi ma de ring nga la 'bras chang dang*// (399)sha dang 'o ma bu ram sbrang rtsi dang*// rdzas kyi 'byor ba cung zhig thugs la thogs// rje btsun a ba dhū ti'i drung du 'gro// bsnyen bkur byed cing bdag rgyud 'dul du 'gro// tshig de rgyal bu dam pas glu dbyangs shing*// yab yum gnyis kyi snyan du phul ba dang*// dri za'i rgyal po'i blu dbyangs blangs pa na// skye bo rnams kyi rig pa g.yos pa ltar// yab yum gnyis kyi shes pa cher g.yos nas// lan ma thebs par rang la gang 'dod gnang*// de nas 'bras chang la sogs zas sna dang*// rta ba stong dang bcas pas nags su phyin// a ba dhū ti mchod pas tshim byas nas// thal mo sbyar zhing zhabs la btud pa dang*// bla mas sems la theg chen dbang bskur mdzad// de tshe 'khor los sgyur rgyal rgyal po la// 'khor gyis bskor zhing 'jigs pa bsrung ba ltar// thams cad rta las mang bas nags khrod na// ho sgra ku sgra sgrogs shing phyogs nas bskor// mel tshe byed cing glu dbyangs mchod pa 'bul// byin brlabs rjes su bla mas 'di skad gsungs// ri bo nag po'i gtsug lag khang du song*// dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa// bka' sdod gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub pa po// dpal ldan rā hu la yi drung du song*// sems bskyed dbang bskur gdams pa dam pa zhus// de yang sngon gyi bla ma dam pa yin// dga' bar rgyu gcig ma bsdad da lta song*// rgyal bus bla ma'i gsung de thos pa dang*// dpa' bo chen po g.yul du zhugs pa ltar// khrab kyi gos can rta pa stong phrag gis// rmog gyon dpa' bo'i ngar sgra chen po yis// st+wa re dgra st+wa tho ba mdud thung phyar// thog mda' 'phen zhing kun nas tshig sgra sgrog

/dga' ga'i glu len gtsug lag khang du rgyu// de nas ri bo nag po'i gtsug lag tu// rnal 'byor pho mo dpag tu med pa la// dpal ldan (400)dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa// gsang sngags rgyud sde gsung gin yod pa la// rgyal bu zla ba gzhon nu byon pa gzigs// chos la byon pa mngon par mkhyen na yang*// thugs rje chen pos bsdigs ri bya ba'i phyir// rgyal po'i steng du thog gcig phab pa na// thog de dbyings nas 'bab du ma 'dod par// mu stegs nag po'i mchod rten ri la song*// de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams ya mtshan nas// rgyal po'i dmag 'di gang lags su zhes gsol// de ma thag tu bla mas lan gsungs pa// skye ba lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum du// rnam dag dge slong mkhas pa'i paṇa chen du// legs par brgyud cing deng sang bhaṃ ga lar// chos rgyal dge ba dpal gyi sras su bltams// 'di 'dra'i 'khor dang rgyal srid chen po la// 'di na ma chags dka' ba spyod par 'dod// ri bo'i zom nas a ba dhū ti pas// nga lung bstan te de ring drung 'dir lhags// ngo mtshar che'o skal ldan pho mo rnams// zhes gsungs pa dang*// kun gyi a la la ho ngo mtshar can// de ring dpa' bo chen po byon pa legs// de nas kun gyis bzhengs te rgyang nas bsus// rgyal bu chen pos chibs las gzhol ba dang*// rta ba stong gis de bzhin rta las babs// de nas bla ma'i pho brang 'khor du byon// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'di skad btab// skyes mchog bla ma dam pa gsan du gsol// khyim nas byung ste thar pa bslab 'dod kyang*// 'di ltar grags pa'i rigs brgyud thob pa yis// bhaṃ ga la ru kho bo 'ching nyen gda'// dze tā ri dang byang chub bzang po dang*// rig pa'i khu byug a ba dhū ti ba// dngos grub brnyes pa'i bla ma bsten gyur kyang*// da dung rgyal srid gnas las ma grol gyur// da ni bla ma nyid gyi drung du btang*// bdag la sems bskyed theg chen dbang bskur gyis// nges par 'ching ba 'di las bsgral du gsol// (401)de nas bla ma dpa' bo dam pa yis// rgyal bu gcig pu dkyil 'khor drung du khrid// dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur mdzad// gsang chen ye shes gsang ba'i rdo rjer btags// nyin dang mtshan du gdams pa'i char pa phab// nyin zhag bcu gsum bar du dbang bskur bgyes// rjes kyi bya ba thams cad tshang bar mdzad// de yi bar du 'khor tshogs thams cad kyang*// ma nyal 'gro dang 'chags dang rtse ba dang*// glu dang gar dang rol mo sna tshogs byed// rgyal bu phyir la nam byon snyam pa las// rnam par rtog pa gang yang ma byung ngo*// nyin mtshan bcu gsum 'das pa'i dus tshod na// rgyal bus he ru ka yi gzugs su byon// 'khor la gzigs shing mi rtag glu dbyangs blangs// 'khor gsum blta zhing snying po med par gzigs// de tshe ngag tu gsol ba'i glu dbyangs ni// pha rol nyag gcig dbyings kyi nam mkha' la// skye med grags stong tshig gi nga ro sgrogs// rgyal srid rmi lam nor 'dra snying po med// 'khor rnams sgyu ma'i tshogs ltar bslu brid yin// thams cad bor nas byang chub ma sgrub na// kho bo skal ldan bsod nams bsags pa min// nyin dang mtshan du gnas lugs don sgom zhing*// rgya chen thos pa rtag tu btsal bar bya// de nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa// mi rtag rang bzhin las kyi rnal 'byor ma// dpa' bo dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs pa'i grub thob pho mo gcer bu brgyad// lag pa g.yas na mi rkang gling bu bzung*// g.yon pas mi sha lag pa so 'drad byed// ngag tu hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrogs// kun nas rgyal bu'i phyir la bskor zhing rgyug

/bhaṃ ga la sogs rgyal bu'i bsam pa sgyur// rgyal bu srid dang pha rol bsam pa sgyur// skyes mchog a ba dhū ti'i drung du skyol// lwa ba'i gos gyon dman pa'i (402)zas kyis skyong*// dar zab stan phrol kṛṣṇa sā ra byin// 'khor dang rta phrol gcig pu ldom bu slob// ma zhum ma zhum thar pa sgrub pa'i dus// nges par gnyen po btsan tshod sgrub ba'i dus// da lta rgyug ces bla mas bka' bsgo mdzad// de nas rgyal bu grub thob cha lugs su// chibs la chibs te rta pa stong gis bskor// lam du zhugs tshe rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa// skye ba med pa sems kyi rdo rje las// 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i theg pa rnyed// shin tu dga' ba nyams kyi rdo rje la// rdo rje'i nyams dang ldan pa'i snang ba shar// gsal la dag pa lha yi rdo rje la// nyes skyon bral ba lus kyi gzugs brnyan shar// rdo rje rin chen lus kyi da la la// bdag med rdo rje 'jigs med snang ba shar// mi rtog ye shes gsang ba'i rdo rje ste// 'khor ba'i g.yul las nges par rgyal bar 'gyur// rgyal bus rdo rje'i mgur de bzhes pa dang*// nang blon chen po dpa' bo rdo rje dang*// blon po chen po phas rgol rab 'joms dang*// blon po chen po skar ma'i rgyal ba dang*// blon po chen po 'jig pa med pa dang*// blon po bzhi yis skyo ba'i glu blangs pa// e ma ho 'jig rten las kyi mthu btsan pa// kun nas bsngags pa za hor yul mchog na// dpal 'byor rgyas pa grong khyer bhaṃ ga la// lta na sdug pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan can// ngo mtshar che'o rgyal po dge ba dpal// 'gro ba'i ma ma lha mo 'od zer can// sprul pa 'dra ba'i blon 'bangs bor gyur nas// rgyal bu dam pa nags su zhugs pa 'dra// rta dang shing rta glang po bzhag gyur nas// dman pa'i tshul bzung rkang 'gros gyed byed 'dra// lha yi rgyan dang na bza' bzhag gyur nas// dman pa'i chas su las pa gyon nyen gda'// rma bya bsnol ba'i khri stan phar bzhag nas// lo ma'i spyil por kṛṣṇa bting nyen gda'// mdzes pa'i lha mo khab tu mi bzhes par// (403)dur khrod 'grim zhing ro zas za nyen gda'// bltams ma thag tu dkar po'i snang ba can// dga' bar 'dus pa 'dral bar phod lags sam// de ltar glu len skyo bas khab tu 'ong*// kun gyis pho brang 'khor du slebs pa na// skye bo kun gyis tshor zhing bltas pa'i tshe// phyogs skyong bcu po rab tu zhugs pa ltar// 'jigs shing dpa' la go cha rab tu sra// mdzes shing mtshar la ya mtshan ltas mo che// sil sil khrol khrol 'ur sgra sna tshogs sgrogs// rang gi rgyal bu lags kyang 'jigs par tshor// zla ba gsum du blon po thams cad kyang*// dmag gi chas gyon rta rnams sga chas sgron// la la tshab 'dren la la glu gar rtse// la la 'thab pa lta bur go gsar byed// rnal 'byor pho mo dag ni mchong zhing rgyug

/rgyal bus grong khyer dbus su smyo spyod skyong*// kun gyis rgyal srid spong bar kha tshon bcad// thams cad phreng zhing mi gnas mchi ma 'byin// khye'u khyu ru gcan gzan lhag pa ltar// yab yum bu phyir mya ngan smre sngags 'don// lhag par yab kyi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// e ma bu khyod legs par btsas pa'i tshe// ya mtshan ltas mthong rgyal srid skyong snyam nas// dga' ba'i sems kyis yid dbang sos par gyur// da ni nags khrod brten nam ji skad lags// rgyal bus smras pa chos rgyal gsan du gsol// ci gsung bdag gis rgyal srid bzung gyur na// tshe 'dir yud tsam yab dang 'grogs mod kyi// skye ba rtag tu pha bur mi shes shing*// phan gnod med na shin tu 'tsheng ba min// bdag gis rgyal srid chen po rab spangs nas// nges par rnam grol byang chub lam 'grub na// skye ba gtan du dga' bder 'grogs su yod// de phyir bdag la go skabs (404)stsal bar mdzod// de nas yum gyi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// ci phan bu 'di shin tu phreng na yang*// skye rgu kun la las kyi 'phen pa gtso// skyes mchog gang su chos la bde bar thongs// phyis nas gtan du 'grogs pa'i smon lam 'tshal// de nas rgyal bu nang par tho rangs nas// rnal 'byor rnams dang lhan cig nags su byon// a ba dhū ti'i drung du dka' thub bsten// chags pa med pa dbu ma'i chos rnams bslabs// dgung lo bcu gnyis lon nas bco brgyad bar// a ba dhū ti'i spyod pa skyong ba la// thos bsam sgom gsum stan thog gcig tu bsgrubs// de nas rje btsun snying rje chen po 'dis// dka' ba brgya phrag du mas 'bad pa yis// rgyal srid chen po bskam gyis mi khyab pa// mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du rab spangs nas// rnam grol chen por thar pa rab tu brnyes// de yi 'gran zla su yang ma mchis pas// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag don grub rab brnyes la// 'brom rje kho bos spyi bo rab btud nas// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bdag phyag 'tshal// 'di la sgro skur dri ma gang mchis pa// thugs rje chen po khyed kyis bzod par bzhes// bla ma'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho las// rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa sgrub pa yi// yon tan rags rim tsam zhig gsungs pa'o// jo bo lha gcig bka' drin che lags so// shu bham// sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa skye bar gyur cig
/'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti sha'i// rgyal srid spangs nas thar ba sgrub tshul gyi// yon tan rags rim tsam zhig brjod pa yis// sems can kun la nges 'byung skye bar shog// /
